label: Director
description: Heads the facility or program (also written Executive Director, Science Director, Station Director).

label: Deputy Director
description: Second in charge under the director.

label: Associate Director
description: Associate or assistant director with a named leadership portfolio.

label: Lead PI
description: Lead principal investigator of a funded site or program (LTER, LTREB, LTAR lead). Several co-leads may hold it at once.

label: Co-PI
description: Co-principal investigator on the site's award; not the lead.

label: Founding PI
description: Founded the site or program; historical, so never superseded by a new holder.

label: Site Manager
description: Runs field operations at the site.

label: Manager
description: Manages the facility or reserve (NERR Reserve Manager, Program Manager, Research Leader).

label: Executive Officer
description: Chief executive of a non-profit, consortium or agency office (CEO, President, Executive Officer).

label: Superintendent
description: Superintendent of a park or protected area.

label: Research Coordinator
description: Coordinates the research program (NERR Research Coordinator).

label: Stewardship Coordinator
description: Coordinates stewardship and restoration (NERR Stewardship Coordinator).

label: Education Coordinator
description: Coordinates education and outreach (NERR Education Coordinator).

label: Information Manager
description: Runs the site's information management system and data catalogue (LTER Information Manager).

label: Data Manager
description: Manages the facility's datasets and data delivery.

label: Domain Manager
description: NEON field-science domain manager; one per domain, recorded on each of its sites.

label: Scientist
description: Research scientist, ecologist, hydrologist or similar staff researcher at the facility.

label: Faculty
description: University faculty member affiliated with the facility.

label: Coordinator
description: Network or program coordinator without a narrower coordinator role.

label: Technical Staff
description: Technician, analyst, GIS or instrument specialist.

label: Emeritus
description: Emeritus or retired scientist still associated with the facility.

label: Former Director
description: Previously directed the facility; kept for history.

label: Leadership Team
description: Member of a named leadership team or executive committee (ARID Institute). Several hold it at once.

label: Advisory Board
description: Member of an external advisory or steering board.

label: Collaborator
description: External researcher who works with the facility; older rows also wrote research-collaborator.

label: Staff
description: Administrative or program staff.

label: Land Manager
description: Agency land-management staff responsible for the ground the facility sits on.

label: Alumnus
description: Former staff member or researcher; historical.
